outcome: knowledge of risks and benefits of different modes of birth
cohort: 361 postpartum women at a university hospital.
finding: The majority of women preferred vaginal birth, citing better postpartum recovery as the primary reason, but many lacked adequate knowledge about the risks and benefits of different birthing methods.
mod_finding: 77.6% of women preferred vaginal delivery, and the reason for 81.8% of these was better postpartum recovery.
